Row.Text: The Kingdom of Prussia emerged as a major European power through disciplined administration, military reform, and the ambitions of the Hohenzollern monarchy. Under Frederick II, Prussia combined an army of exceptional efficiency with a court shaped by the European Enlightenment.

Prussia turns Golden Ages into periods of exceptional scientific and military strength. Time Golden Ages for decisive campaigns, train elite forces in the Staff College, and decide whether each General Staff Officer is worth more on the battlefield or as an immediate scientific breakthrough.
Frederick the Great, philosopher-king of Prussia, history remembers both your cultivated mind and your iron resolve. Enlighten your state, perfect your army, and make Prussia the arbiter of Europe.

Frederick II (1712–1786) ruled Prussia from 1740 until his death. An accomplished musician and correspondent of Enlightenment thinkers, he also transformed Prussia into a great power through administrative reform and a succession of hard-fought wars.
During a Golden Age, gain +20% [ICON_RESEARCH] Science and +20% [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength for all military units.

The Prussian General Staff developed from institutions that selected, educated, and assigned officers for the detailed planning of campaigns. Its officers turned professional study, mapping, and logistics into instruments of state power.

The General Staff Officer replaces the Great General. It projects Leadership and may construct a Citadel as normal, or it may be expended for the same research boost as a Great Scientist. It cannot construct an Academy.

Prussian unique Great Person replacing the Great General. Provides the normal Great General combat bonus to nearby units and may construct a Citadel. May instead be expended to provide the full Great Scientist research boost. Cannot construct an Academy.

The Prussian Kriegsakademie trained selected officers in military history, strategy, tactics, geography, and administration. Its graduates formed the intellectual core of a professional officer corps and the later General Staff.

The Staff College replaces the Heroic Epic and retains all of its normal effects. Land and naval combat units trained or purchased in this city receive Morale, Leadership, and Great Generals II, and keep these promotions when upgraded.

Replaces the Heroic Epic. Provides all normal Heroic Epic effects. Land and naval combat units trained or purchased in this city receive Morale, Leadership, and Great Generals II. These promotions are retained upon upgrade.
Fortune has decided against me. Use your victory more wisely than most princes would.
Your appetite for land is becoming impossible to ignore. Prussia will not watch in silence.
I am Frederick of Prussia. Let us discover whether reason can govern relations between sovereigns.
You return. I had hoped necessity would spare me the conversation.
Welcome. A capable ruler is always worth hearing.
Your soldiers crowd my frontier. Withdraw them, or accept the conclusion any prudent king would draw.
Prussia can supply this luxury. What will you offer in return?
Open borders would serve us both, provided neither mistakes courtesy for weakness.
I have a proposal that should interest a rational sovereign.
